description: Use it when the video needs music under it and the user has none. Search background music tracks. Write query as 2 to 4 English words, a mood and an instrument or genre, such as "calm piano" or "upbeat corporate"; the source does not use the words of a longer query (over about 50 characters it answers with every track), so the tool then searches the words that fit in 50 characters and says so in searched_as. Vietnamese and other languages give poor matches, so translate first. genre narrows the search, for example "intro outro", and can be used without a query. duration is one of the length ranges 0-30, 30-120, 120-240 or 240-480 seconds; pick the one that holds the length the edit needs. Each result has a direct mp3_url, the author, duration_seconds and two flags from the source: has_youtube_content_id (true: a YouTube upload may get a Content ID claim; tell the user. false only means the source knows of none: one track marked false still got a claim) and is_ai_generated. Tracks reported to EditAtlas as claimed are left out, and left_out_claimed says how many on that page. 20 results per page; raise page for more. No tempo comes with a track: to cut on the beat, download it and run beat_grid.py from the sound-design skill (get_skill with name sound-design) for the BPM, every beat and the bar starts.

genre.description: Optional genre, such as intro outro

query.description: English words for the mood, style or use

name: search_music
